title: Labor Delta shows quoted minus worked hours; signed to one decimal
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S4-R23,S4-R24,S4-E2; heading renamed to Labor Delta per SV-9071)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. The Labor Delta column is turned on.
  3. The report shows: a job under its labor estimate (fewer hours clocked than quoted), a job that has overrun its estimate (more hours clocked than quoted), and a job at exactly its quote.
steps:
1. Read the Labor Delta value of the under-estimate job.
  2. Read the Labor Delta value of the overrun job.
  3. Read the Labor Delta value of the exactly-on-quote job.
expected:
1. Labor Delta shows the quoted labor hours minus the worked (clocked) labor hours across the approved lines, as a signed number with one decimal place — for example "+2.0" or "-14.0".
2. On screen it is colored green when positive and red when negative; the overrun job shows a negative red value, the under-estimate job a positive green value.
3. A value of exactly zero shows unsigned as "0.0" (never "+0.0" or blank) in the default text color.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S4-R23, S4-R24, S4-E2), read on 18 August 2026. The column was renamed from "Inv. Hrs" to "Labor Delta" per SV-9071; only the name changed.
